modeling_goal: Composition-derived tabular descriptors predicting Materials Project energy_above_hull for validation-method demonstration.

not_a_claim: not new DFT calculation by this repository

prediction_context.intended_use: Compare baseline tabular validation strategies for computed Materials Project properties.
not_intended_use: replacement for DFT or laboratory validation

primary_feature_tier.name: composition_only_descriptors
allowed_processing: parse composition into numeric composition descriptors
derive reduced formula and chemical-system grouping columns
primary_feature_tier.not_in_v1_3_1: No descriptors are generated in this contract phase.

optional_comparison_feature_tiers.name: property_assisted_computed_features
optional_comparison_feature_tiers.policy: Use only in a separately labeled comparison experiment because these are Materials Project computed outputs, not early composition-only descriptors.

leakage_candidates.reason: Derived from convex hull stability and directly tied to energy_above_hull.
Thermodynamic computed property closely related to stability calculations.
Raw categorical formula can leak formula-family identity when randomly split.
Identifier only; never a predictive feature.

uncertainty_policy.v1_3_initial_policy: Report validation metrics and residual/error summaries only.

interpretation_limits: Modeling would predict Materials Project calculated energy_above_hull, not experimental stability.
Composition-only baselines cannot prove synthesizability or process feasibility.
Random split performance should be treated as optimistic until group splits are checked.

minimum_data_requirements.valid_target_rows: must be sufficient for train/test and group splits after acquisition
minimum_data_requirements.target_distribution: must not be effectively constant or dominated by a single mass at zero

stop_conditions: Valid target rows are too few for model validation.
Distinct reduced-formula groups are too few for group split.
Distinct chemical-system groups are too few for group split.
Target is nearly constant or dominated by zero values.
Composition parsing failure rate is high.
Database or package version is not recorded.
